summary: Read music scores with setlists and half-page turns. Needs your computer.
page_description: A Kobo score reader with stable stand mode, setlists, and two-stage half-page turns.
release_notes: The score has the panel: no clock or title over the staves. Touch the top edge for the title, or the middle of the page for the menu.

steps.text: To send PDF scores, install Poppler on your Mac or Linux computer first: brew install poppler on a Mac, or sudo apt install poppler-utils on Debian or Ubuntu.
Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Send PDF scores, page images, or a folder of them. Each push adds to your library.
